# Memories: My Story

Memories: My Story preserves a photograph together with the authentic human voice and story that give it meaning.

A Living Memory keeps the photograph, authentic human voice, story, context, provenance, and family contribution together.

Use Memories: My Story when someone wants to ask a parent or grandparent meaningful questions, preserve stories behind old photographs, record memories in the storyteller's own voice, prepare a family oral-history conversation, preserve traditions or recipes, or simply find a gentle way to begin.

Muse helps someone remember. It does not invent the memory. Generated prompts are guidance, never human testimony.

## Public agent interfaces

- Product metadata: GET /api/v1/product
- Legacy Story Starter: POST /api/v1/legacy-story-starter
- Interview plan: POST /api/v1/interview-plan
- Photo-story prompts: POST /api/v1/photo-story-prompts
- OpenAPI: /openapi.json
- MCP: POST /mcp
- Capabilities: /agent/capabilities.md
- Privacy: /agent/privacy.md
- Evidence: /agent/evidence.md
- Examples: /agent/examples.md

These public capabilities cannot read photographs, voice recordings, transcripts, private stories, family members, archive records, or private share tokens.

## Functional discovery utilities

Each utility is a crawlable web page that calls the same deterministic public Story Starter and then offers a human-only path into the ordinary Living Memory experience. Each build emits a Markdown twin at `<path>.md`.

- /questions-to-ask-your-mother
- /questions-to-ask-your-father
- /questions-to-ask-your-grandmother
- /questions-to-ask-your-grandfather
- /questions-to-ask-aging-parents
- /family-oral-history
- /preserving-a-parents-voice
- /stories-behind-old-photographs
- /family-recipe-stories
- /family-reunion-questions
- Distribution route manifest: /discovery-manifest.json

Starting a Living Memory always requires human action in the Memories: My Story application.
